items.item_text: Experience in care of LGBTQ and Diverse populations.
Provide direct patient care in general obstetrics and gynecology.

Be responsible for clinical duties that include occasional outpatient care; daytime laborist on labor and delivery; obstetric day call; obstetrical night call in-house; at home gynecology call in rotation; and inpatient nighttime hospitalist duties on labor and delivery, including urgent and emergent gynecologic surgery.

Additional hospitalist responsibilities include OB triage, labor management, postpartum care, initial evaluation and admission of antepartum patients, ER coverage, emergency surgeries and inpatient consults.
Provide teaching and supervision of residents and medical students in labor and delivery, the operating room and the inpatient wards for any admitted patients as the attending physician.
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary healthcare team to enhance patient outcomes and ensure the highest standards of care.
Participate in administrative meetings held to support departmental initiatives and operations while adhering to all relevant department and clinic policies.
